notes.notes:
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]If Chapter Select was chosen before playing the game for the first time, the menu disappeared and the game had to be killed to return to Windows/macOS.
[*]The Chapter Select menu item is now never greyed out, as a message is displayed if you try to run the game before you've finished it.

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Please feel free to report issues via Send Diagnostics (in the game's menu), or send me an email (support@basedontheplay.com) or a Steam chat request.
[*]If you like the game, please consider writing a review - it really helps.  :)
[*]Watch out for a new code on social media soon (to unlock more stuff for Lux). 
[*]Hey Jess, I don't have a Win 7 machine or VM set up, so I can't easily test it. If you can send me an error report or a log showing the error though, I can try and work out why it's not working. The game is only officially supported on Win 10 though at the moment but I'll do my best to try to resolve it. And yes, that pic in the Hart house is the real Tahiti.  :)
[/list]

[h1]Have a nice weekend all![/h1]

notes.title: Hotfix build 20190920 is live
notes.notes:
I know we just had an update yesterday, but I finally solved some really nasty camera bugs today and I wanted to publish the fixes ASAP. As always, please let me know if you run into any problems. And have a nice weekend.  :)
 
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The player would sometimes lose control of the camera after Lux had killed a group of enemies. Fixed.
[*]Fixed a bug which would sometimes force the camera to lock on to explosive props after a battle had ended. 
[*]Disabled dynamic batching to work around a bug in Unity 2018.4 which could cause some machines to crash (YAHPEAU_EXCEPTION_POINTERS).
[*][Dogan Outpost] Lux now turns to face the car before casting Incinerate to ignite it.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix build 20190810 is now live
notes.notes:
This build addresses some new issues reported in the last 48 hours. I try not to update more than once a week, but a couple of people have reported a new issue in Dogan Outpost that's stopping them from progressing, so we need to fix that right away.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][Dogan Outpost] Fixed a game-breaking bug where Ibrahim's mission sometimes wouldn't be triggered when Lux entered his shop. 
[*][Hart Residence] The collectibles for a postcard and a document were not being spawned in the Hart Residence. This was preventing the Hoarder achievement from being awarded. 
[*][New Shinjuku] A section of the road and some of the buildings were not being rendered near the Fast Travel Station. I found an issue with the textures there and I'm pretty sure I've fixed this now. However, I can't reproduce the problem, so please let me know if it's still not rendering correctly.
[*][Genji Metro Station] Fixed stairs at the far end of the map which led to nowhere (with Lux falling through the terrain).
[/list]

notes.title: Major update incoming on December 12
notes.notes:
Hey all,

The game will be updated next Wednesday. The update will bring a lot of changes, including the new combat mechanics, the Appearance system, bug fixes and performance enhancements.

However, with so many changes in the underlying code, I had to change the save file format. This means that from next week, you’ll lose your progress as your save file will be deleted. I’m really sorry about this but it’s the downside of Early Access: because the game is still being developed, your game can be affected. Hopefully it will be worth it.  :)

Resequenced will be auto-updated by Steam on December 12, so if there’s an achievement you want to complete, now’s the time to do it. 

I hope you enjoy the changes. This update prepares the game for lots of new features which will be implemented in 2019. I’ll be updating the Roadmap later today to let you know more about that.

notes.title: The next update is nearly ready!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Apologies for the long delay between updates!

The good news is that the big update is nearly ready. The combat system is finished, and I’m just completing an all-new Appearance system which will replace Outfits. We should be able to start beta-testing in about a week, with a general release to everyone in mid-December.

Here are the main features:
[list]
[*] [u]New combat system[/u]: It’s much more fluid and dynamic. Lux can now move while firing and reloading, and RHETT’s new targeting system helps her lock-on to enemies and easily switch targets.
[*] [u]New Appearance system[/u]: Instead of 27 fixed outfits, there are now hundreds of different items which can be mixed together to create your own outfits. Dead enemies now drop clothing and hair designs in their loot.
[*] [u]Performance improvements[/u]: Average memory usage has dropped from 5GB to 3.2GB. This helps the game run much more smoothly, especially on PCs with 8GB of RAM.
[*] [u]Bug fixes and feedback requests[/u]: I’ve listened to your feedback, and all of the biggest bugs have been fixed. For example, you can now just run over loot dropped by enemies to pick it up, and the Level Up bug is fixed. The scanner behaviour has been improved, there's a new command to bring up a large map, and Lux can now jump as well as roll. And lots more - too many changes and fixes to list here!
[/list]
There’s still a lot more to be done, but I want to get this update out to you ASAP, and then I’ll work on the next batch of changes.

That’s all for now - enjoy your weekend!

All the best,
Pete Carnac

notes.title: Developer Update: June 4, 2018
notes.notes:
Hi all, welcome to another week! I’ll be posting regular updates here for anyone who’s interested - this is the first. They’re not essential reading, but probably worth a quick scan if you’d like to know where we’re at with the game.

So, a lot was accomplished over the last week. I finished adding our two most important Steam features: Cloud Save and Achievements, and they’re working nicely.

Also, Lux can now carry medkits and shield energy packs to use when needed. She can carry three of each by default, and carry additional supplies by upgrading her inventory capacity in the Skills panel. Her maximum stamina (how long she can run at top speed) can now also be upgraded. Spend those skill points wisely, folks!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32616396/e5f596e0d2a8da2eb8ffc8e401079004ad878713.jpg[/img]

One thing I’d like to complete before the EA release date is to ensure each level is populated with enough content. For example, in one chapter Lux visits a small town in Japan which has been overrun with infected people (a.k.a. zombies). The storyline and missions are all completed and working, but the town itself seemed too placid and deserted at night, so I’ve added a lot more zombies, and it’s really a big improvement. I’ll be doing this right across the game: adding more random enemies that can be fought (for XP and loot) or just ignored.

Also, Lux’s max health and stamina now increase slightly each time she levels up. I actually took this idea straight from Assassins Creed: Origins.  :)  From memory, I think Fallout 3 and 4 also both increase your character’s health each time you level up.

The rest of the week was taken up with various bug fixes. When the game goes live, I’ll post a list of recent bug fixes here.

Tomorrow I’ll get onto making another video, and I’ll send out a post when it’s ready.

That’s all for now - enjoy your week!
